policy: Most uploaded songs already contain their own broadcaster intro. Do not add automatic between-song announcer or station-ID material. Tuning/static transitions remain part of the radio. Optional audio inserts are only for specific gaps that are identified later.

plannedAudioInserts.script: Optional only. Use if a specific track is confirmed to have no broadcaster intro and needs a short station bridge.
Optional final signoff only if the finished closing song does not already contain one.
